name: Armstrong of Gilnockie

intro.text: Gilnockie, we say, and we mean it. Johnnie Armstrong rode out to meet the King in his finest, expecting a pardon, and was hanged for his trouble. We still take it personally. Right, then. Ye ken the Bishop's curse? Let's see if ye can survive an Armstrong.

win: Well fought. You've earned a drink and, I'd say, a chair.
after: The Bishop of Glasgow's curse lasted 500 years. I've decided it ends today.
